Btw, I really like this map of Africa you made on DeviantArt. It shows the biomes, and the interesting forest greening in the Sahara.

I was wondering if I could be given permission by you to use it at some point in the future. I have so far failed to create an in-depth scenario, but I intend to. The Second Renaissance has helped me think outside of the box.
